'''Matthew Moghadam The Destiny Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matthew Moghadam]]
* '''Published:''' October 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' The Destiny Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH The Destiny Deck Moghadam LS 1996.txt |Download]]
